DESCRIPTION:THIS AGREEMENT PROVIDES FUNDING UNDER THE INFRASTRUCTURE INVESTMENT AND JOBS ACT TO VAN POOL TRANSPORTATION. THIS AGREEMENT IS TO REPLACE EXISTING SCHOOL BUSES WITH ZERO EMISSION SCHOOL BUSES.

ACTIVITIES:THE ACTIVITIES INCLUDE REPLACING 40 DIESEL SCHOOL BUSES WITH 40 TYPE C ZERO EMISSIO
